sentences.text: Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to issue an interim order allowing the petitioner to continue the  manufacture and marketing the two brands of coconut oil namely Hrudayam  and Nalla which are already registered with Food Safety and Standards Act  as evident from Exhibit P5 license issued, notwithstanding Exhibit P-16  order, pending decision of the above WP(C).

This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's order dated  16.11.2021 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S T.V.AJAYAKUMAR and RIMJU  P.H., Advocates for the petitioner and of SRI.K.V.SOHAN, STATE ATTORNEY  for R1, R2 and R3, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Post on 10.12.2021.
Interim order is extended till 10.12.2021.
Sd/- P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN, JUDGE 23-11-2021 /True Copy/
